subject: Dispatch subordinate stimuli through the live patrol chief
description: SuN1Sh1nE Profile_004 Savegame_016 replay-011 diverged because a subordinate predicted that its detected chief would accept EventSeesShadow, queued a generic Think, and suppressed its own handler. Original directly calls the chief's DispatchStimulusToWholePatrol and uses the routine's actual boolean; an empty chief records the stimulus, returns false, and the subordinate handles it locally. A typed synchronous patrol-dispatch request now invokes the live chief routine and resumes the caller only on false, with required selected-default-Wait metadata. The focused empty-patrol regression passes; Task264 completes the successful-chief owner boundary.
